title: The diff pickers refuse a CLI run without focus and show no picker (file-pages-r96 picker phase)
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab
macOS's /var/empty (an empty, root-owned folder) is in no git repository: open-diff passes it as openDiffViewer's path, so the step does not depend on the pane's folder

steps.note: a CLI run without focus may not change the view, so the picker refuses with its needsFocus reason (ViewerHandlers.showPicker); on db82ac3effe (the parent of 788d648a9ec) it opened the picker and answered ok
after the run's work settled, no palette page is open
`path` names a folder with no repository, so the diff read fails and the picker would ask for one; without focus the work refuses with the same reason (ViewerHandlers.backgroundPickerRefusal)

invariants: neither refused run opens a palette page, a sheet or a tab: the overlays and tabs facets equal the launch's
the focus stays on the launch terminal (a run without focus changes no view)
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the refusal's text (The picker opens only when focus is requested.): driver_app reads no error details yet, and the text is localized
the script's keys phase (Cmd-K, Cmd-[ and Cmd-] in a markdown tab): it needs file fixtures that driver_app does not build (fixture.repo, $CASE_ROOT paths)

the script's grants, crash, dontsave and restore phases: page input through debug.page, the WebContent kill, quit sheets, an app crash and a relaunch (no case-v1 step or app crash kind; restart is p15-oracle-023 in the app driver)
the bytes on disk after each save: no snapshot facet reads file contents
